graph_universe.definition: all 310 atolls with complete physical geometry and biogeographic distances
graph_universe.role: physical network nodes and intermediate stepping nodes regardless of whether the focal atoll is model-eligible

model_target_universe.definition: atolls complete for all prospectively frozen response-independent R0/R1 numeric predictors

spatial_block_selection_rule: choose the largest frozen graph radius whose all-310 connected-component partition has at least 11 model-target-eligible components and whose largest physical component contains no more than 50 percent of all 310 graph nodes; STOP if no radius qualifies
model_target_eligible_component: selected physical component contains at least one of the 292 model-target atolls
block_id_rule: 'SC_' + first12(sha256('|'.join(sorted(all physical atoll names in component))))
isolation_quantile_universe: 292 model-target atolls; response quality cannot change this distribution
source_pressure_scale: median centroid nearest-neighbour distance among all 310 physical atolls
generic_gateway_rule: at a frozen graph radius, physical component contains an atoll with major_landmass_distance <= that radius
